title: Mint the production admission service credential and sign the first real admission

blockers.description: No authenticated private transport exists between the Cloud signer (recipient_admission.py) and the sprintctl private adapter/lookup/ledger; no route, receiver or end-to-end delivery qualification.
blockers.resolved_by: source item: disposable mTLS Cloud signer endpoint plus owner-only orchestrator with negative tests (missing/wrong client cert, caller-supplied recipient, revoked grant, expired assertion, JTI replay, no message on refusal)

blockers.description: The exact deployment/service identity and certificate target are not determined.
blockers.resolved_by: architecture decision from the actual deployment and qualification, recorded under docs/decisions

why_operator: A production service credential is minted through cred-broker step-up approval, and the signing key is operator-held; no credential has been minted (handoff 2026-11-06).

preconditions.check: The transport and identity blockers are closed by merged, reviewed source
preconditions.command: Read the blockers' work items; each must be merged with exact-head CI green

commands.command: credctl explain <scoped capability for the admission signer>
commands.expected: the decision that would be taken, with no credential value printed
step-up approval recorded; decision receipt ID printed

expected_result: One scoped, short-lived service credential issued for the reviewed signer identity, a decision receipt, and one real admission delivered end to end.
send_back: Decision receipt ID (never the credential value)
The admission's delivery receipt or refusal text

rollback.description: Revoke the grant through cred-broker's revocation path (exact command to be stated by the transport source item) and let the short-lived credential expire; the one-use ledger prevents replay.
